Interface OwnerDao

All Known Implementing Classes:
JdbcOwnerDao
public interface OwnerDao
Data Access Object for Owner entities. Defines CRUD operations and JSON serialisation for owners.
Author:
Michal Salabura

      Uploads an image and associates it with the specified owner.

      contentType - the MIME type of the image (e.g. image/jpeg)
      fileSize - the size of the image file in bytes
